title: Draft Comprehensive README.md
description: Create a detailed README.md file for the AI Schedule Auditor project, covering all essential aspects for developers and users.
details:
Write a README.md that includes:
- Project overview and purpose
- Key features (chat interface, AI event extraction, calendar view, metrics dashboard, authentication, etc.)
- Tech stack (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Vercel AI SDK, etc.)
- Setup instructions (local development with Docker Compose, production deployment on Vercel)
- Usage instructions (how to sign up, use chat, view calendar, etc.)
- Contribution guidelines (if applicable)
- License and contact information
Ensure the README is clear, concise, and formatted with Markdown best practices. Use headings, bullet points, and code blocks where appropriate.
test_strategy: Review the README for completeness, clarity, and accuracy. Verify that all sections are present and instructions are correct. Optionally, have a team member follow the setup and usage instructions to ensure they work as described.
